faqs.question: How do I enquire about an appointment?
faqs.answer: Choose a service and fill in your preferred date, time and address. Review your details, then send the enquiry through WhatsApp. Your appointment is confirmed only after the business replies.

faqs.question: Is my appointment confirmed when I fill in the form?
faqs.answer: No. The form sends an enquiry through WhatsApp, but it does not confirm an appointment. An appointment is confirmed only after you speak with the business and agree on availability and service details.

faqs.question: How much do the services cost?
faqs.answer: Prices have not been published. Please discuss your chosen service and requirements with the business before agreeing to an appointment.
